title: Win Big with Euromillions, Irish Lotto, and American Jackpots
heading: Weekend Lottery Roundup
description: Play for a chance to win €158 million with Euromillions, €7 million with Irish Lotto, or soar to new heights with American Powerball and Mega Millions. Good luck!
author: Lotto Express Marketing
body_html:
IT’S EUROMILLIONS TIME!

There are fantastic opportunities worth exploring for our lottery spend this week. We saw the big French lotto jackpot reported here come off the board. The Irish Lotto continues to climb. American jackpots are coming to life. However, this week our primary focus turns to Euromillions – now sitting at an astounding €158 million!

Euromillions has All-Time Top 10 Jackpot in its sights

March 24 was the last time Euromillions had a jackpot winner. We’ve seen eleven rollovers since that date and the jackpot has climbed into some very rarified air.

Looking at the Top 10 Euromillions jackpots ever awarded we see a July 2022 UK winner taking down €230,000,000 million sitting at the top. Further down the list we see four separate jackpots of €190 million sitting in slots seven through ten.

The current €158 million jackpot is extremely intriguing. Two more rollovers should land us into the top 10. Regardless though, with a newly announced superdraw just around the corner… we are guaranteed to have multiple nine-figure jackpots in the next month.

Will you be the one to win the big one? Be in it to win it… Save 45% when you buy 5 boards at Lotto Express!

The Luck of the Irish

The Irish Lotto now sits at €7 million… March 18 was the last time the Irish Lotto had a jackpot winner. We’ve seen thirteen rollovers since that date.

Lotto Express clients love playing the Irish Lotto because of its amazing jackpot odds in relation to all other European Jackpots.

This Saturday’s jackpot is definitely worth a flutter… particularly when saving 45% off the regular price at Lotto Express when you purchase five Irish Lotto boards.

Check it out now and get into the action!

Born in the USA!

American Powerball and American Mega Millions both feature jackpots that climb quickly. Two weeks ago we faced two jackpots sitting at the minimum. Times have changed.

Punters playing American Mega Millions will be in the hunt for an estimated $68 Million this Friday night.

American Powerball – which draws 3 times per week – has seen additional rollovers and now sits at $87 Million drawing this Saturday.

American games are more fun to play for with large jackpots like these.

There is so much worldwide lottery action going on… all of best can be found at LottoExpress.

Good Luck everybody on your weekend plays.
